sections.title: Warmer, colder
sections.content: To compare two things, add -bb to the adjective (with a linking vowel when the word ends in a consonant cluster or would otherwise be hard to say): meleg → melegebb ("warmer"), hideg → hidegebb ("colder"). Use mint ("than") to name what you're comparing to: Nyáron melegebb van, mint télen. ("In summer it's warmer than in winter.")

items.english: In summer it's warmer than in winter.

items.spanish: Az ősz hidegebb, mint a nyár.

sections.content: Word order matters: put mint right before what you're comparing to — melegebb, mint télen, not mint télen melegebb.
